HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Special Treatment in Laundry Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Careers in Home Management 3.0 Cl and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Maternal Health care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
